summary: In-flight header growth + edge proxy slow-flush causing delayed TTFB and intermittent 502/504 for streaming completions
description:
Issue summary: Customer Langtail Labs reports a sharp rise in streaming request failures and delayed first-byte times starting 2026-03-11 late afternoon. Symptoms include delayed TTFB (10-30s), intermittent 502/504 responses, and client-side timeouts on long completion streams. Impact: production traffic for several endpoints sees ~15% of streaming sessions fail or time out during peak; customer reported user-visible degradation in chat product. Environment: Dedicated tenancy (reserved capacity) fronted by Redwood API gateway -> edge-proxy (nginx-based) -> serving runtime pool in us-east-1.

Observed behavior aligns with header growth (rotating trace/cookie headers and sidecar metadata) increasing request header sizes mid-stream while edge proxy is coalescing small upstream writes, causing proxy buffering and a long pause before the first flush to client. When pause exceeds ALB/edge idle_timeouts, upstream connections are reset and clients receive 502/504.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create a long-running streaming completion request (simulate >20s tokens) using a client that rotates a large trace header per chunk (replicate Langtail's instrumentation),
2) Send frequent small upstream writes from serving runtime (1-2KB) to force proxy coalescing,
3) Observe edge-proxy buffering behavior and time-to-first-byte from client side,
4) Compare with same workload but with header rotation disabled or with proxy_buffering off.
logs_excerpt:
edge-proxy/nginx error: upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.12.45.2, server: _, request: "POST /v1/streams/completions HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.20.3.5:8080/", host: "api.langtail.example"
ALB logs: target:10.20.3.5:80 connection_reset, request_processing_time=0.000, response_processing_time=31.245
investigation_notes:
- Initial timeline shows spike correlating with rollout of Langtail's telemetry sidecar (version 2.4) which began rotating X-Trace-ID headers per chunk.
- Proxy metrics show increased proxy_write_backlog and decreased flush frequency; nginx config had proxy_buffering enabled with default buffers causing delayed flush until buffer full or timeout.
- ALB idle timeout (60s) wasn't the direct cause for many failures, but internal edge keepalive resets occurred when proxy held data without sending to client.
- No evidence of serving-runtime CPU/GPU saturation; token emission steady.
- Reproduced in staging by running sidecar header rotation + slow upwrites; turning off header rotation eliminated the pause.
- Hypothesis: header growth (and occasional header re-send on HTTP/2) combined with proxy coalescing and default send timeouts cause a TTFB pause long enough to trip upstream health checks or ALB resets.
resolution: Mitigation applied: Updated edge-proxy nginx config in prod-us-east to set proxy_buffering off for streaming routes and increased proxy_send_timeout to 90s. Also raised http2 max header size and hpack-table-size to accommodate rotating telemetry headers. Notified Langtail to roll back frequent per-chunk header rotation as a durable fix. Monitoring added to alert on proxy_write_backlog > 50 and TTFB > 5s for streaming endpoints.
resolution_notes: Deployed config change via infra PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2143 at 2026-03-13T02:10Z; no immediate regressions in canary (5% traffic).
Workaround for customer: disable per-chunk header rotation or batch tracing metadata into a single header set at request start; customer confirmed reduced failure rate in their canary within 2 hours.

Follow-up: create a hardened default streaming nginx profile that disables proxy_buffering for streaming routes and documents recommended header size limits in public docs. Assigned follow-up task INT-542 to platform infra.
comments: Maya Chen (Support): Logged initial customer report and collected request IDs and ALB logs. Pushed to SRE for triage.
Omar Patel (SRE): Confirmed reproduction in staging. Built nginx config patch and created infra PR. Monitoring alert rule created.
Langtail engineering (via reply): Provided evidence that telemetry sidecar rotated X-Client-Trace every 3s; agreed to test batch-mode. Requested postmortem URL once resolved.
SRE note: Need to validate http2 header budget behavior under heavy header mutation; consider adding automatic header-size rejection if rotating headers exceed limit.
